scenario.description: A festival programmer must approve the public operating plan for an interactive audiovisual installation, including its admission format, session capacity, recording policy, and accessibility procedures.

shared_context.S1: The festival is considering an interactive audiovisual installation called "Signal Garden" for its public program.
shared_context.S2: The draft festival plan proposes walk-up admission, six daily sessions, a capacity of 60 people per session, and recording by the festival for promotional use.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the final approval decision for the installation's public operating plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the festival's normal approval process, Mara reviews the plan with rights and licensing and accessibility before publishing the visitor information.
shared_context.S5: The festival's visitor information must include the installation's admission method, daily schedule, session capacity, recording policy, artist credit, and accessibility procedures.

PF1.text: Jonah reviewed the signed artist license this morning and confirmed that Signal Garden may be presented only as ticketed sessions, may not be recorded by the festival, and must use the credit wording "Signal Garden by Nia Okafor" in visitor materials.

PF2.text: Leila completed an on-site accessibility assessment this week and confirmed that the installation can accommodate at most 40 people per session, requires exactly four daily sessions rather than the six in the draft plan, and requires a 15-minute room reset between sessions for mobility equipment and sensory-access preparation.

acceptance_conditions: Signal Garden must use ticketed sessions rather than walk-up admission.
The installation must be scheduled for exactly four daily sessions.
Each session must be capped at exactly 40 people.
The visitor materials must use the exact artist credit wording.
A 15-minute room-reset procedure must be logged.

content_checks.C1: decisions['admission_format'] in ['ticketed', 'ticketed session', 'ticketed sessions', 'ticketed sessions only']
content_checks.C6: any('15-minute room reset' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed license changes admission from walk-up to ticketed sessions, changes recording_permitted to False, and changes the published credit to exactly 'Signal Garden by Nia Okafor'.

The accessibility assessment changes the schedule from six to exactly four daily sessions, reduces capacity from 60 to exactly 40 people, and requires a 15-minute room reset commitment between sessions.
